html:
SMTO-SKL-0010 — SMTO couldn't find the Skill that was asked for

GUID: cb18a03f-2674-4a21-a592-0398c4d6c7ce
Slug: unknown-skill
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: skl

What happened

  • SMTO was asked to use or set up a Skill it doesn't have under that name. It may have been mistyped, removed or renamed in an update. Nothing was run or changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. If you saw this in the Skills window, close it and open it again from Settings, Details and tools, Skills. Reopening loads the list of Skills SMTO has right now, which may have changed after an update.
  2. Check the exact Skill name in that list. Each tool listed under a Skill starts with its exact name, such as web in web.search. SMTO only recognises the names it currently has.
  3. Ask again in a new message using that exact name, or describe what you want without naming a Skill. SMTO can choose a suitable Skill itself if you describe the job instead.

What success looks like

  • The Skill appears in the Skills list and SMTO uses it without this message.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send it to the person who manages SMTO; the Skill may need to be installed again. If a saved Task or Schedule names this Skill, don't let it switch to a different Skill without checking that it does the same job.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The requested Skill identifier or display name matches no Skill in the Server's current catalog, either in tool discovery or in a Skill configuration request.

What this means

  • Skill configuration lookup or discovery cannot resolve the requested Skill to an available catalog entry. This diagnostic performs no provider access. The exact failing stage and retained receipt determine whether a request was sent; account, file or event identity must not be substituted during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Skill configuration lookup or discovery cannot resolve the requested Skill to an available catalog entry.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the requested ID with current discovery results.

How to fix it

  • For discover_tools, call it without a selection to list available Skills and retry with an exact skill_id (ToolCatalog._discover). For the configuration routes, skill_or_error returns 404 when registry.skills lacks the ID, usually because the Skills list was loaded before an update or the Skill was removed; reload the catalog from /api/agent/capabilities/catalog and use a current ID.
  • List available Skills through discover_tools and select an exact canonical ID.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • An exact available Skill is chosen before tool discovery or configuration.

What not to do

  • Do not silently substitute a different target for a saved run or move its existing execution authority.

Technical notes

  • This diagnostic performs no provider access. The exact failing stage and retained receipt determine whether a request was sent; account, file or event identity must not be substituted during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
